component.name: Noisedeck Sync
component.summary: Local video and audio bridge for Noisedeck

description.p: Sync receives browser video frames and publishes them to native video outputs. It also connects native audio inputs to Noisedeck.
On Linux, Sync runs as a user service with no tray window. Start the service, then run syncctl pair in a terminal before connecting from Noisedeck.
